86:def parse_newc(data):
87:    """Reject unsafe paths, links, duplicates, truncation and nonzero trailer data."""
88:    offset, members, payloads = 0, {}, {}
89:    while offset < len(data):
90:        if offset + 110 > len(data) or data[offset:offset + 6] != b"070701":
91:            raise RuntimeError("invalid/truncated newc header")
92:        header = data[offset + 6:offset + 110]
93:        if any(c not in b"0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for c in header):
94:            raise RuntimeError("invalid newc hexadecimal fields")
95:        fields = [int(header[i:i + 8], 16) for i in range(0, 104, 8)]
96:        offset += 110
97:        mode, nlink, size, namesize = fields[1], fields[4], fields[6], fields[11]
98:        if namesize < 1 or offset + namesize > len(data):
99:            raise RuntimeError("invalid/truncated newc name")
100:        name_raw = data[offset:offset + namesize]
101:        if name_raw[-1:] != b"\0" or b"\0" in name_raw[:-1]:
102:            raise RuntimeError("invalid newc name terminator")
103:        name = name_raw[:-1].decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
104:        end_name = offset + namesize
105:        offset = (end_name + 3) & ~3
106:        if offset > len(data) or any(data[end_name:offset]) or offset + size > len(data):
107:            raise RuntimeError("invalid newc name padding/payload bounds")
108:        payload = data[offset:offset + size]
109:        end_payload = offset + size
110:        offset = (end_payload + 3) & ~3
111:        if offset > len(data) or any(data[end_payload:offset]) or fields[12] != 0:
112:            raise RuntimeError("invalid newc payload padding/check field")
113:        if name == "TRAILER!!!":
114:            if size or mode or any(data[offset:]):
115:                raise RuntimeError("invalid newc trailer or trailing data")
116:            return members, payloads, len(data) - offset
117:        relative = PurePosixPath(name)
118:        if not name or relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts or str(relative) != name:
119:            raise RuntimeError("unsafe/noncanonical newc member")
120:        if name in members:
121:            raise RuntimeError("duplicate newc member: " + name)
122:        kind = stat.S_IFMT(mode)
123:        if kind not in (stat.S_IFDIR, stat.S_IFREG) or mode & 0o7000:
124:            raise RuntimeError("unexpected newc member type or special permission")
125:        if (kind == stat.S_IFDIR and size) or (kind == stat.S_IFREG and nlink != 1):
126:            raise RuntimeError("directory payload or hardlinked newc file")
127:        members[name] = {"type": "file" if kind == stat.S_IFREG else "directory",
128:                         "mode": stat.S_IMODE(mode), "bytes": size,
129:                         "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}
130:        payloads[name] = payload
131:    raise RuntimeError("newc archive has no trailer")
